about_short_description.short_description: Al Baraka Bank Egypt is a banking institution that provides investments and services.

product.name: Personal Accounts and Deposits
product.description: Sharia-compliant personal savings, current investment accounts, certificates of deposit, time deposits, and simplified accounts for holding funds and receiving profit distributions.

product.name: Personal Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant personal financing for eligible individuals, with repayment structures designed for general personal needs.

product.name: Corporate and Project Financing
product.description: Corporate financing for companies and institutions, including direct facilities, structured finance, syndication, commercial activity financing, and project funding.

product.name: Cards
product.description: Sharia-compliant credit cards and debit cards for payments, cash access, and account-linked transactions, including worldwide-accepted card options.

product.name: Business Accounts and Deposits
product.description: Current investment accounts, time deposits, and USD certificates for businesses seeking transactional banking and Sharia-compliant investment products.

product.name: Global Transactional Banking
product.description: Corporate transaction banking services supporting payments, collections, liquidity management, trade-related flows, and account-based business operations.
